mentions.name: Shannot
mentions.description: A human-in-the-loop sandbox for AI agents on production systems. Instead of filtering commands with heuristics, it dry-runs entire scripts in a PyPy sandbox, captures every command and file operation, and shows exactly what will happen before anything executes. Supports checkpoint/rollback to undo changes, with example scripts for common sysadmin tasks like nginx config, log cleanup, and cert audits.
mentions.problem: Heuristic command filtering for AI agents can be worked around by the agents, leaving production systems at risk.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building Shannot, a human-in-the-loop sandbox for AI agents on production systems.
